status: Gate GSP06 (SP06/b Tech Info prefetch), registered before any measured run. Derived from the session draft drafts/gsp06-draft.json; changed before any measured run after the non-measurement wiring smoke on this image: the warm request follows its cold pair 1 s later (--warm-delay 1, interval 6 s). With an immediate warm request and a 2 s Tech Info, the background fetch is still in flight, its budget (counted from the prefetch start) is used up, so the warm request neither waits nor gets the data; a second request is user-driven and not instantaneous in practice. Fixed; a new attempt is a new version.
item: SP06/b: C0 = legacy (tech_info_prefetch off, breaker off) vs C6 = prefetch (tech_info_prefetch on, top 5, 20 in flight, 10 s background timeout; breaker off).

source.manifest_method: sha256 over 'path:git-blob-id' lines of git ls-tree -r HEAD server/app
source.candidate_contents: feature/stream-performance with the C2 relay default (5c14f1e), the SP05/b breaker on by default (2595eaf; both arms set it to 0 in-process) and SP06/b prefetch off by default; the harness sets tech_info_prefetch per arm in-process

harness.what_is_real: API-key/DB auth, Stremio/provider/repository path, IndexerSearchService, shared source search (singleflight, deadline, .torrent download/store, SP06/b prefetch with the definitions registry as in the product DI), Tech Info enrichment (1.5 s budget, shared cache, prefetch flights), filter/sort/serialization.
harness.what_is_synthetic: tracker adapters (latency with per-tracker jitter streams), .torrent download latency, nCore-like Tech Info stub (fixed latency per variant, failures a function of seed, torrent and attempt). No real tracker, account or network; external HTTP is blocked and counted.
harness.enrichment_marker: the fixture NFO has a Hungarian subtitle track and the torrent names do not, so 'Felirat' in a stream description means Tech Info reached it

runner: scripts/run_sp_search_gate.py: one fresh --network none container per run (cpuset 0,1, 2 CPU, 1 GiB); per repetition the variant order rotates and both arms of a variant run back to back (arm order rotated); repetition r uses --seed 20261110 + r for both arms; 2 series x 5 repetitions x 4 variants x 2 arms = 80 runs.
time_note: Time scale 1 (the 1.5 s budget is a code constant). 24 cold requests every 6 s, each with a warm pair 1 s later: ~150 s per run plus container start, ~3.5 h in total.
why_seed_per_rep: Repetition r runs both arms with --seed 20261110 + r: the arms of a repetition see the same search-jitter sequence (one stream per tracker, untouched by Tech Info lookups) and the same Tech Info failure draws (a function of seed, torrent and attempt), while the repetitions sample different sequences, so the bootstrap over repetitions includes the sequence variance.

expected_mechanism.t02: C0 waits ~0.2 s for Tech Info after the .torrent downloads; C6 starts it after the tracker phase, parallel with the 0.2 s downloads -> cold ~0.2 s faster, identical attributes.
expected_mechanism.t10: C0 waits ~1.0 s; C6 only the rest of the budget from the prefetch start -> cold ~0.2 s faster, identical attributes.
expected_mechanism.t20: Both time out on the cold request (1.5 s < 2.0 s); C0 cancels the fetch, so the warm request pays 1.5 s again and gets nothing; C6's background fetch completes and fills the cache -> warm request enriched and faster.
expected_mechanism.t10f: 10% failed lookups (TechInfoUnavailableException); never cached in either arm (SP06/a), retried on the next request.

wiring_smoke: Not a measurement (image above, --smoke): t10 cold 1710 -> 1498 ms with 4/4 enriched streams in both arms; t20 with an immediate warm request: warm 1513 -> 10 ms but 0 enriched in both; t20 with --warm-delay 1 and 10% failures: warm enriched 0 -> 3-4 per request.

decision_rule.statistic: per-run steady-window (cold requests 2..23 and their warm pairs 1 s later) latency p50/p95 (ms) and mean enriched streams per request; pooled n = 10 runs per arm and variant; difference of means; 10 000 bootstrap resamples, seed 20261111; one-sided p-values; Holm per family at alpha 0.05
pass_if_all: the three improvements are significant after Holm: t02 and t10 cold steady p50 lower, t20 warm enriched streams higher
no guard regression after Holm over 24 tests (latency p50/p95 beyond a 5 ms margin, enriched streams with no margin; cold and warm, every variant)
identical per-request source digests in every variant and identical rendered streams (attributes) in t02 and t10 across all runs of both arms
candidate minus baseline Tech Info calls per cold request <= 5 (tech_info_prefetch_top_n) in every variant
descriptive_only: t10f enriched streams vs failure draws
decision_rule.guard_margin_note: A latency worsening of at most 5 ms (below perception; warm requests take ~10 ms and the decider detects sub-millisecond systematic differences, cf. gsp05-v1 S1 warm p95) is not a regression; enriched streams have no margin.
